run_xlsum_evaluation_task: run the XLsum multilingual summarization evaluation task for a given language and data split
create_generation_task_config: create a GenerationTaskConfig for XLsum with custom max generation length and prompt length
postprocess_summarization_predictions: postprocess model predictions by extracting the first sentence and pairing with target summaries
configure_rouge_scoring: configure ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L, and ROUGE-Lsum metric evaluation for summarization outputs
map_xlsum_language_codes: map XLsum language names to NLLB language codes for cross-lingual model compatibility
